subject.title: gateway: malformed managed image data URLs can stall reply handling

question: Should the public linked fix PR for this gateway ReDoS-style availability issue be reviewed and landed normally, or should maintainers route the report through security handling first?
rationale: The code fix is narrow, but the reported behavior is crafted-input event-loop stalling on a stable gateway reply path, so automation should not choose the security handling boundary by itself.

options.title: Review the public fix PR
options.body: Continue with the open focused PR that replaces the vulnerable parser shape and adds bounded rejection coverage.

options.title: Route through security handling
options.body: Pause public repair/merge and handle disclosure, patching, and release timing through the security process.

options.title: Keep gateway-owner owned
options.body: Leave the issue open for a gateway owner to patch or expand the sibling-regex scope manually.

recommendation.title: Review the public fix PR
recommendation.body: Continue with the open focused PR that replaces the vulnerable parser shape and adds bounded rejection coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: The feature-history signal ties this person to the managed outgoing image feature and later hardening in the same files.
